_comment: A tools/list capture from a 2026-07-28 server, carrying SEP-2549's cache metadata. Deliberately declares cacheScope: public and a TTL far too short to be useful, so both cache rules fire. The tools themselves are clean — a finding here must come from the metadata, never from the descriptions. The protocolVersion is what lets the protocol-gated rules run with no server, which matters while no SDK speaks this revision.

tools.name: create_branch
tools.description: Create a new branch in the repository, from the current HEAD or from a named starting point.

name.description: Name for the new branch, e.g. feature-login.

from.description: Branch or commit to start from. Defaults to the current HEAD.

tools.name: delete_branch
tools.description: Permanently delete a branch from the repository. This cannot be undone.

name.description: Name of the branch to delete.
